rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Agent PR volume overwhelms review capacity; most receive no explicit review.
rationale.ai-review: Mines routine bot review of agent-authored pull requests in practice.
rationale.quality-debt: Measures acceptance and structural-complexity gaps in agent-authored pull requests.
rationale.risk-routing: Proposes complexity-and-risk-based reviewer tiering to preserve scarce human capacity.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Finds missing persistent AI authorship metadata and demands standardized attribution.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: Massive agent PR volume and sparse review anchor the scaling problem.
rationale.survey-input: Large-scale adoption and review-allocation findings inform organizational survey items.
rationale.agentic: Studies autonomous agents delivering complete pull requests for repository-level review.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports acceptance and complexity findings about agent-authored code quality.
rationale.method-mining: Mines GitHub pull requests, reviews, timelines, commits, and repository metadata.
